candidate_recall_at_1.definition: Proportion of queries where the true matching geographic entity is the top ranked candidate (Rank #1)
candidate_recall_at_1.population: All queries with an authoritative target entity in gazetteer

candidate_recall_at_5.definition: Proportion of queries where the true matching geographic entity appears within the top 5 candidates
candidate_recall_at_5.population: All queries with an authoritative target entity in gazetteer

candidate_recall_at_10.definition: Proportion of queries where the true matching geographic entity appears within the top 10 candidates
candidate_recall_at_10.population: All queries with an authoritative target entity in gazetteer

mean_reciprocal_rank.definition: Mean reciprocal of the rank of the first relevant entity match
mean_reciprocal_rank.population: All queries with an authoritative target entity

exact_hierarchy_accuracy.definition: Proportion of cases where Locality, District, State, and PIN all match authoritative LGD records simultaneously

locality_accuracy.definition: Proportion of cases where the resolved locality matches the ground truth locality

district_accuracy.definition: Proportion of cases where the resolved district matches the ground truth district
district_accuracy.population: Queries with asserted or implied district

state_accuracy.definition: Proportion of cases where the resolved state matches the ground truth state
state_accuracy.population: Queries with asserted or implied state

pin_accuracy.definition: Proportion of cases where the resolved 6-digit postal code matches the ground truth PIN

verification_status_accuracy.definition: Proportion of address verification decisions matching ground truth categorical verdict (VERIFIED/CONSISTENT, NEEDS_REVIEW, INCONSISTENT, AMBIGUOUS, UNABLE_TO_VERIFY)

ambiguity_f1.definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for ambiguous vs non-ambiguous locality classification
ambiguity_f1.population: Queries containing homonymous or insufficient-context entities
ambiguity_f1.aggregation: Binary F1 with AMBIGUOUS as positive class

temporal_resolution_accuracy.definition: Accuracy of historical entity identification and date-sensitive validity assignment (VALID_FOR_DATE, HISTORICAL, CURRENT, OUTSIDE_DATE_RANGE)
temporal_resolution_accuracy.population: Queries with historical aliases, prior names, or reference dates

landmark_spatial_accuracy.definition: Proportion of landmark mentions correctly identified, mapped to spatial coordinates, and bucketed into proper distance ranges

multilingual_alignment_accuracy.definition: Proportion of mixed-script tokens and administrative abbreviations correctly recognized, expanded, and mapped
multilingual_alignment_accuracy.population: Queries with Indic scripts, mixed scripts, or administrative abbreviations

expected_calibration_error.definition: Weighted average of difference between confidence and empirical accuracy across 10 equal-width probability bins

brier_score.definition: Mean squared difference between predicted verification confidence probabilities and true binary outcome (1=Valid/Verified, 0=Invalid/Conflicting)

calibration_reconciliation_audit.reconciliation_finding: The two reported numbers reflect distinct datasets and calibration pipelines: 0.0270 is the validation-set metric during the 7-stage ablation progression, while 0.0171 is the calibrated score on the held-out partition in the dedicated calibration evaluation module. Both are mathematically sound within their respective evaluation contexts.
